en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a landscaped park. In the foreground is a circular pond with a tall central fountain jet and flower beds around it. Behind the fountain is a rocky cascade with numerous statues and plants, framed by broad staircases on either side. At the top stands an ornate pavilion or belvedere with a pointed roof among tall trees. Two well‑dressed men in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the path in the right foreground. Printed German text in red appears at the top of the image.
